objective: Start the next research round under the mandatory long-history protocol using genuinely long pre-2026 BTCUSDT and ETHUSDT spot history. Search a frozen causal next-open rule space on 2017-2022, freeze survivors, independently confirm on 2023-2024, freeze again, then apply a 2025 pre-OOS temporal gate. 2026 remains unopened.

data.source: Official Binance Data Vision spot monthly klines

search_space.feature_family: causal OHLCV features inherited from the audited causal-next-open factory: ATR-normalized returns/range/body/wicks, RSI7/14, SMA distance states, ATR regime, hour/day-of-week, volume z-score
search_space.execution: signal known after source bar close; entry at next bar open; exit at open after frozen holding horizon; year-boundary returns fail closed

gates.discovery: aggregate 2017-2022 edge_atr > 0.018, fast p < 0.005, at least 4 of full years 2018-2022 positive
gates.confirmation: 2023 and 2024 both positive; pooled HAC edge_atr > 0.012; BH-FDR <= 0.05 across frozen discovery candidates; at least one adjacent discovery-fitted quantile remains positive
gates.pre_oos_2025: annual HAC edge_atr > 0.008; BH-FDR <= 0.05 across frozen confirmation survivors; both half-years positive; at least 3 of 4 quarters positive

post_survivor_filters: realistic economic cost and stress-cost replay
broker/MT5 fidelity only for a small finalist set
forbidden: same-sample retuning after any gate is opened
using 2026 to select or rescue R7 candidates
promoting a statistical survivor directly to an EA
